# SolarLists

> SolarLists (solarlists.com) publishes Ohio homeowner solar guides for Dayton, Columbus, Cincinnati and nearby cities, written by a professional solar consultant based in Tipp City, Ohio. It explains buying a system versus third-party ownership (TPO / $0 down), utility net metering (AES Ohio, Duke Energy Ohio, AEP Ohio) and roof and shade checks. Homeowners can request a no-pressure consult; requests go to the consultant directly (call or text (937) 777-9093). SolarLists does not invent installer names, savings figures or prices.
